jumpingJacks.name: Jumping jacks
jumpingJacks.purpose: Raises your heart rate and body temperature before lifting.
jumpingJacks.tip: If you'd rather not jump, step out to the side instead.
jumpingJacks.step1: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
jumpingJacks.step2: Jump your feet apart and raise your arms overhead.
jumpingJacks.step4: Keep an easy pace for 30 seconds.

walkingKneeHug.name: Walking knee hug
walkingKneeHug.purpose: Mobilizes the hips and wakes up glutes and hamstrings.
walkingKneeHug.tip: If you lose balance, do it in place with a hand on a wall.
walkingKneeHug.step2: Lift the other knee and hug it to your chest.
walkingKneeHug.step3: Hold for a second with your back straight.

armCircles.name: Arm circles
armCircles.purpose: Warms the shoulders through their full range.
armCircles.tip: Only the arms move; keep your torso still.
armCircles.step1: Stand with your arms out to the sides.

catCamel.name: Cat-camel
catCamel.purpose: Mobilizes the spine one segment at a time.
catCamel.tip: Move without forcing it; this is mobility, not a stretch.
catCamel.step1: Get on hands and knees, hands under shoulders.
catCamel.step2: Round your back to the ceiling and tuck your chin.
catCamel.step3: Drop your belly and look forward.

bodyweightSquat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweightSquat.purpose: Prepares knees, hips and ankles for squatting.
bodyweightSquat.tip: Knees track over your toes; don't let them cave in.
bodyweightSquat.step1: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
bodyweightSquat.step2: Sit your hips back and down with your chest up.
bodyweightSquat.step3: Go as low as you can with heels down.
bodyweightSquat.step4: Drive through the floor to stand.

lungeTwist.name: Lunge with twist
lungeTwist.purpose: Opens the hips and mobilizes the mid-back.
lungeTwist.tip: Keep the front knee over the foot, not past it.
lungeTwist.step1: Take a long step forward into a lunge.
lungeTwist.step2: Rotate your torso toward the front leg.

legSwingFront.name: Front-to-back leg swing
legSwingFront.purpose: Mobilizes the hips and prepares the hamstrings.
legSwingFront.tip: Control the swing; don't aim high from the first rep.
legSwingFront.step1: Stand side-on to a wall or support.
legSwingFront.step2: Swing the outside leg forward and back.

legSwingSide.name: Side leg swing
legSwingSide.purpose: Mobilizes the hips sideways and prepares the adductors.
legSwingSide.tip: Keep your hips facing the wall while the leg moves.
legSwingSide.step1: Face a wall with your hands on it.
legSwingSide.step2: Swing one leg side to side in front of the other.

gluteBridge.name: Glute bridge
gluteBridge.purpose: Activates the glutes before squats, deadlifts and lunges.
gluteBridge.tip: If you feel it in your lower back, lift a bit less and squeeze harder.
gluteBridge.step1: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
gluteBridge.step2: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips.
gluteBridge.step3: Hold a second at the top, body in a line.

hipHinge.name: Hip hinge
hipHinge.purpose: Teaches and warms up the deadlift pattern.
hipHinge.tip: A stick along your back (head, upper back and hips) helps keep it straight.
hipHinge.step2: Push your hips back with a straight back.
hipHinge.step3: Lower until you feel tension behind your thighs.

ankleRock.name: Wall ankle mobility
ankleRock.purpose: Improves ankle bend so you can squat deeper.
ankleRock.tip: If you touch the wall easily, move the foot back a bit.
ankleRock.step1: Face a wall with one foot a hand's length away.
ankleRock.step2: Drive the knee toward the wall without lifting the heel.

bandLateralWalk.name: Banded lateral walk
bandLateralWalk.purpose: Activates the side glutes so the knees don't cave in.
bandLateralWalk.tip: If the band pulls your knees in, use a lighter one or move it to the ankles.
bandLateralWalk.step1: Put the band above your knees, feet hip-width apart.
bandLateralWalk.step2: Sit into a half squat, chest up.
bandLateralWalk.step3: Step sideways without bringing the feet together: keep the band tight.
bandLateralWalk.step4: Take your steps one way, then come back.

bandMonsterWalk.name: Banded monster walk
bandMonsterWalk.purpose: Activates the glutes in every direction of the hip.
bandMonsterWalk.tip: Short, controlled steps; knees always pushing out.
bandMonsterWalk.step1: Band above the knees, in a half squat.
bandMonsterWalk.step2: Walk forward diagonally, opening each step.
bandMonsterWalk.step3: Keep the band tight the whole time.

bandGluteBridge.name: Banded glute bridge
bandGluteBridge.purpose: Activates the glutes harder than a regular bridge.
bandGluteBridge.tip: If the band wins and your knees close, use a lighter one.
bandGluteBridge.step1: Band above the knees, lying on your back.
bandGluteBridge.step2: Push your knees out against the band.
bandGluteBridge.step3: Lift your hips, squeezing the glutes.
bandGluteBridge.step4: Lower slowly without letting the knees close.

thoracicRotation.name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
thoracicRotation.purpose: Mobilizes the mid-back, key for presses and rows.
thoracicRotation.tip: Keep your hips still; the turn comes from the back.
thoracicRotation.step2: Put one hand behind your head.
thoracicRotation.step3: Rotate that elbow to the ceiling, following it with your eyes.

scapularPushUp.name: Scapular push-up
scapularPushUp.purpose: Activates the muscles that move the shoulder blades before pushing.
scapularPushUp.tip: You can do it from your knees.
scapularPushUp.step1: Hold a plank with straight arms.
scapularPushUp.step2: Without bending the elbows, let your chest sink between the shoulder blades.
scapularPushUp.step3: Push the floor away and spread the shoulder blades.

wallSlide.name: Wall slide
wallSlide.purpose: Prepares the shoulders for overhead work.
wallSlide.tip: Only go as high as you can while keeping contact.
wallSlide.step1: Stand with your back to a wall, lower back against it.
wallSlide.step2: Put your arms in a W, elbows and hands on the wall.
wallSlide.step3: Slide your arms up without losing contact.

bandPullApart.name: Band pull-apart
bandPullApart.purpose: Activates the upper back and rear shoulders.
bandPullApart.tip: Don't shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
bandPullApart.step1: Hold the band in front of your chest, arms straight.
bandPullApart.step2: Pull your hands apart, bringing the band to your chest.
bandPullApart.step3: Squeeze the shoulder blades at the end.

bandDislocate.name: Band dislocate
bandDislocate.purpose: Moves the shoulder through its full range.
bandDislocate.tip: If it doesn't pass easily, widen your grip.
bandDislocate.step1: Hold the band with a very wide grip in front of your hips.
bandDislocate.step2: With straight arms, raise it overhead.

bandExternalRotation.name: Band external rotation
bandExternalRotation.tip: A towel between elbow and body helps keep it in place.
bandExternalRotation.step1: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand side-on.
bandExternalRotation.step2: Elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.

standingQuad.name: Standing quad stretch
standingQuad.purpose: Stretches the front of the thigh.
standingQuad.tip: You should feel it in the thigh, never pain in the knee.
standingQuad.step1: Put one hand on a wall for balance.
standingQuad.step2: Bend one knee and hold the ankle with the same-side hand.
standingQuad.step3: Pull the heel toward your glute, knees together.
standingQuad.step4: Hold without bouncing, then switch legs.

seatedHamstring.name: Seated hamstring stretch
seatedHamstring.purpose: Stretches the back of the thigh.
seatedHamstring.tip: A straight back matters more than reaching your foot.
seatedHamstring.step1: Sit with one leg straight and the other bent.
seatedHamstring.step3: Reach toward your foot until you feel tension.

kneelingHipFlexor.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
kneelingHipFlexor.purpose: Stretches the front of the hip, which tightens from sitting.
kneelingHipFlexor.tip: Put something soft under the down knee.
kneelingHipFlexor.step1: Kneel with one leg forward in a lunge.
kneelingHipFlexor.step2: Squeeze the glute of the back leg.

figureFour.name: Figure-four glute stretch
figureFour.purpose: Stretches the glute and outer hip.
figureFour.tip: Relax your head and shoulders on the floor.
figureFour.step1: Lie on your back with knees bent.
figureFour.step2: Cross one ankle over the other knee.
figureFour.step3: Hold the lower thigh and pull it toward your chest.

butterfly.name: Butterfly stretch
butterfly.purpose: Stretches the adductors, the inner thigh.
butterfly.tip: Don't push your knees down with your elbows; let them fall.
butterfly.step1: Sit and bring the soles of your feet together.
butterfly.step2: Hold your feet with your hands.
butterfly.step3: Let your knees drop toward the floor.
butterfly.step4: Lean forward slightly with a straight back.

wallCalf.name: Wall calf stretch
wallCalf.tip: Bend the back knee slightly to stretch the lower calf.
wallCalf.step1: Hands on a wall, one foot back.
wallCalf.step2: Back heel down and leg straight.
wallCalf.step3: Move your hips toward the wall.

doorwayChest.name: Doorway chest stretch
doorwayChest.purpose: Stretches the chest and front of the shoulder.
doorwayChest.tip: If your hand tingles, lower the elbow a little.
doorwayChest.step1: Rest your forearm on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height.
doorwayChest.step2: Step forward with the same-side leg.

wallLat.name: Wall lat stretch
wallLat.purpose: Stretches the lats, the wide back muscles.
wallLat.tip: Hanging from a bar also stretches the lats.
wallLat.step1: Face a wall and put your hands on it at hip height.
wallLat.step2: Walk back with your arms straight.
wallLat.step3: Push your hips back and let your chest drop.

crossBodyShoulder.name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
crossBodyShoulder.purpose: Stretches the back of the shoulder.
crossBodyShoulder.tip: Keep the shoulder down, away from your ear.
crossBodyShoulder.step1: Bring one straight arm across your chest.
crossBodyShoulder.step2: Hold it above the elbow with the other arm.

overheadTriceps.name: Overhead triceps stretch
overheadTriceps.tip: Keep your head upright; don't push it forward.
overheadTriceps.step1: Raise one arm and bend the elbow behind your head.
overheadTriceps.step2: Hold the elbow with your other hand.

childPose.name: Child's pose
childPose.tip: Spread your knees if your belly needs room.
childPose.step1: Kneel and sit back on your heels.
childPose.step2: Fold forward with your arms straight.
childPose.step3: Rest your forehead on the floor.
childPose.step4: Breathe deeply and let your back relax.

gentleCobra.name: Gentle cobra
gentleCobra.purpose: Stretches the abs and mobilizes the lower back.
gentleCobra.tip: If your lower back complains, rest on your forearms.
gentleCobra.step1: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
gentleCobra.step2: Press into the floor and lift your chest.
gentleCobra.step4: Only go as high as is comfortable.

warmup.title: Warm-up
warmup.note: Active movements and activation: they prepare you without sapping strength. You can turn the warm-up off in Settings.

ramp.title: Ramp-up · optional
ramp.note: Weight climbing up to your working weight. They don't count toward your sets or records.

stretch.title: Stretches
stretch.minutes_one: ~{{count}} min · for what you trained today
stretch.minutes_other: ~{{count}} min · for what you trained today
stretch.note: Stretching improves mobility; it doesn't prevent soreness. No bouncing, no pain.
